_comment: Pots this mupot core deploys to. `pots` = DEPLOYMENT entries only (scripts/mupot-update.mjs deploys them; scripts/staleness-check.mjs enforces them). `config: null` = the repo default wrangler.toml (mumega's pot). `db` = the D1 database name. `required_slug` (optional) = the deployment slug the staleness check requires in `pots` (default mumega; env STALENESS_REQUIRED_SLUG overrides). `legacy` = frozen entries: probed by the staleness check for information only (never fails the run) and skipped by mupot-update. See #2107.
